# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn.objects as so
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}


def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl


table_number = 0


def get_next_table_number():
    global table_number
    table_number = table_number + 1
    return table_number

import numpy as np
from python_scripts import routes
pl_excluded = {}
pl_end_cat_map = routes.get_end_cats_map()
pl_outcomes = dpw_pls.set_index("vac_id")
pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_reason"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
next_pls = (dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_vac_id"].notna()]
            .rename(columns={"vac_id": "next_vac_id", "prev_vac_id": "vac_id", "svc_type_short": "pathway"})
            .set_index("vac_id"))
next_pls["pathway"] = next_pls["pathway"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes.loc[next_pls.index, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move"
pl_outcomes.loc[dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_svc_id"] == dpw_pls["svc_id"], "prev_vac_id"].values, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move: same service"
#TODO: fix duration dates for internal moves to same service
same_svc_dates = (dpw_pls.groupby(["route_id", dpw_pls["svc_id"].diff().ne(0).cumsum().fillna(0)], as_index=False)
                  .agg(vac_id=("vac_id", "last"), pl_start_dt=("pl_start_dt", "first"), pl_end_dt=("pl_end_dt", "last"))
                  .set_index("vac_id").drop(columns="route_id"))
pl_outcomes["pathway"] = pl_outcomes["svc_type_short"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes["pathway_type"] = (pl_outcomes["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
pl_outcomes["ended"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "Current", False: "Ended"})
tbl = get_frequencies(pl_outcomes[["ended", "pathway_type", "pathway_level"]], sort=False, dropna=False)
tbl.loc[tuple(["All"] * len(tbl.index.levels)), :] = tbl.sum()
tbl = tbl.convert_dtypes()
tblno = get_next_table_number()
tbl_desc = f"Table 4.{tblno}: Placements in different pathway levels"
excel_output[tbl_desc] = tbl
print("### " + tbl_desc)
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
level_diff = (pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move", ["pathway", "pathway_level", "vac_address_outward_code"]]
              .join(next_pls[["pathway", "pathway_level", "vac_address_outward_code"]].add_prefix("next_")))
level_diff[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]] = level_diff[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]].astype("Float64")
# Difference in level is meaningful except that moves to/from SU pathway are different..
for prefix in ["", "next_"]:
    level_diff.loc[level_diff[prefix+"pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway", prefix+"pathway_level"] = (
        level_diff.loc[level_diff[prefix+"pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway", prefix+"pathway_level"]
        .map({1: 2, 2: 3}))
level_diff = (level_diff.assign(level_diff=lambda df: df[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]].diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]))
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes.join(level_diff[["next_pathway", "next_pathway_level", "level_diff"]])
pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["level_diff"].notna(), "pl_end_cat"] = (
    "Internal move: " + np.sign(pl_outcomes.level_diff).map({-1: "backwards", 0: "sideways", 1: "forwards"})
)
# Exclude 738 placements that have not ended
pl_excluded["Not-ended placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].isna()]
pl_excluded["Not-ended placements"]["dur"] = (
    pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - pl_excluded["Not-ended placements"]["pl_start_dt"]))
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].notna()]
# Exclude 42 0-day placements
pl_excluded["Zero-day placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] == pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] > pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome (external)': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    'Other': ['Other'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
pl_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in pl_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in pl_outcomes_map[outcome]}
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
pl_outcomes.loc[
    pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].fillna("").str.startswith("Internal move"),
    "pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"]
# Exclude 1,310 moves within the same service
pl_excluded["Moves within same service"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move: same service"]
# Exclude 277 moves due to end reasons: 53 missing reaons, 200 "Other"
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"].fillna("Other")
# TODO: Should "Other" really be excluded?

# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")

def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl

# 3.1 Entry point into BAHSA services
#####################################
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
rt_entries["pathway"] = rt_entries["svc_type_short"]
rt_entries["pathway_type"] = (rt_entries["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})

#####################################
# 3.2 Route outcomes after 3.08 years
#####################################
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )]
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dv_dict["Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = (
                          dpw_rt_outcomes[["route_id", "rt_outcome"]].set_index("route_id"))
#######################################################################
# 3.3 Outcomes at a period of time after a person's first route started
#######################################################################
# dpw_cli_outcomes is the dpw_rt_outcome that is active after the measured time since the person's first route started
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
# Relevant date for each client is their first route start date plus the time measure period
dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes
                          .set_index("o_cli_id")
                          .groupby("o_cli_id")
                          .head(1)
                          ["rt_start_dt"]
                          + time_measure).rename("cli_timemeasure_dt")
dpw_cli_outcomes = dpw_rt_outcomes.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id").set_index("o_cli_id")
# Select the latest route that started before the outcome date
dpw_cli_outcomes = ((dpw_cli_outcomes[dpw_cli_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] <= dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_timemeasure_dt"]])
                    .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)).rename(columns={"rt_outcome": "cli_outcome"})
cli_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id")
cli_pls_at_timemeasures = cli_pls[(cli_pls["pl_start_dt"] < cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  & (
                                      cli_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                      | (cli_pls["pl_end_dt"] > cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  )].set_index("o_cli_id")
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[cli_pls_at_timemeasures.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
equiv_ind_at_time = cli_pls_at_timemeasures[
    (cli_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No")
    & cli_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"])]
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[equiv_ind_at_time.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_start_dt"] = (dpw_rt_starts.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                    .groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)["pl_start_dt"])
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_end_dt"] = (dpw_rt_ends.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)["pl_end_dt"])
dv_dict["Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"] = (
                          dpw_cli_outcomes[["cli_outcome"]])
##############################################
# 3.4 Returning to use services multiple times
##############################################
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["multiple_returns"] = (dpw_rt_starts.groupby(['o_cli_id']).size() >= 3).rename("multiple_returns")
dv_dict["People with multiple returns during 7.5 yrs"] = (

################################
# 3.5 Using services longer-term
################################
durations = dpw_pls.set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"]).groupby(["o_cli_id", "route_id"]).sum()
# Set threshold to top 10% of route durations
longer_term_threshold_days = durations.quantile(0.9)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"] = ((durations > longer_term_threshold_days)
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").any())
dv_dict["People with a route in top 10% of route durations"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["has_longer_term_rt"]])
######################################################################
# 3.6 Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation
######################################################################
# Note: Not enough returns after moves to independent accommodation to analyse much further.
# time_measure options: ['90d', '6m', '15m', '18m', '2y', '5y']
time_measure = "2y"

return_col = f"after_rt_ret_within_{time_measure}"

                          eligible_route_ends[["route_id", return_col]].set_index("route_id"))

section: Create cross-tabulations for each DV and IV combination
text:
Create cross-tabulations for each DV and IV combination

Code
for ch in characteristics:
    print("### " + ch)
    print("")
    for dv_desc in dv_dict.keys():
        dv_df = dv_dict[dv_desc]
        idx_type = dv_df.index.name
        match idx_type:
            case "vac_id":
                iv_df = dpw_pls
            case "route_id":
                iv_df = dpw_rt_starts
            case "o_cli_id":
                iv_df = dpw_clis
        iv_df = iv_df[[idx_type, ch]].set_index(idx_type)
        tbl_desc = f"Cross-tabulation of {dv_desc.lower()} by {ch}"
        ct_df = dv_df.join(iv_df, how="inner").assign(n=1)
        tbl_n = pd.pivot_table(ct_df,
                               values="n",
                               index=list(dv_df.columns),
                               columns=list(iv_df.columns),
                               aggfunc="count",
                               margins=True).astype("Int64")
        tbl_pct = 100 * tbl_n / tbl_n.iloc[-1, :]
        print(tbl_desc + " (n)")
        excel_output[tbl_desc + " (n)"] = tbl_n
        display(tbl_n)
        print("")
        print(tbl_desc + " (pct)")
        excel_output[tbl_desc + " (pct)"] = tbl_pct
        with pd.option_context("display.float_format", '{:,.1f}%'.format):
            display(tbl_pct)
        print("")

import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import seaborn.objects as so
sns.set()
# Set up data
#############
durations = dpw_pls.set_index("route_id")[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"])
hist_data = (
    durations.groupby(level=0).dur_days.sum().to_frame()
    .join(dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id")["pl_end_dt"].notna().rename("ended").astype("category"))
    .join(dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id")[["rt_end_cat", "soc_move_type"]])
)
hist_data = hist_data[hist_data["rt_end_cat"] == "To social housing"]
hist_data = hist_data.drop(columns="rt_end_cat")
hist_data = pd.concat([hist_data, hist_data.assign(soc_move_type="All")])
hist_data["ended"] = pd.Categorical(hist_data["ended"], categories=[True, False], ordered=True)
hist_data["dur_years"] = hist_data["dur_days"] / 365.25
colours = sns.color_palette(as_cmap=False)
# Calculate positions of separators between groups for log unit labels
days_logunits = {"day": 1, "week": 7, "month": 365.25/12, "year": 365.25}
days_loglists = {
    "days": [1, 2, 4],
    "weeks": [1, 2],
    "months": [1, 2, 4, 8],
    "years": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]
}
days_logsep = []
for (a_u, a_l), (b_u, b_l) in zip(list(days_loglists.items())[:-1], list(days_loglists.items())[1:]):
    a_end = days_logunits[a_u[:-1]] * a_l[-1]
    b_start = days_logunits[b_u[:-1]] * b_l[0]
    log_midpoint = 10 ** ((np.log10(a_end) + np.log10(b_start))/2)
    days_logsep.append(log_midpoint)
# Calculate positions of group labels for log units
days_loggrp_edges = [0.8] + days_logsep + [30 * days_logunits["year"]]
days_logpos_grp = list(10 ** ((np.log10(a) + np.log10(b))/2) for a, b in zip(days_loggrp_edges[:-1], days_loggrp_edges[1:]))
# Calculate order for facets
facet_order = ["All", "Local authority", "Housing association"]
# Generate human-readable units and tick positions for log timescales
#####################################################################
days_logunits = {"day": 1, "week": 7, "month": 365.25/12, "year": 365.25}

                                     / route_outcomes[("outcomes", "n")].sum())
for k, v in stable_periods.items():
    route_outcomes[k, f"Eligible (n)"] = (soc_move_grp["pl_end_dt"]
                                 .apply(lambda x: (x < stable_period_max_end_dts[k]).sum()).astype("Int64"))
    for outcome in ["Yes", "No"]:

def cust_plot(rc_params={}, annot_color="black"):
    return (
        so.Plot(data=plotdata, y="% returned", x="years", text="index")
        .facet("End reason", wrap=4, order=facet_order)
        .label(x="", y="")
        .add(so.Dot(), data=plotdata[plotdata["index"] != ""])
        .add(so.Line())
        .add(so.Area(edgewidth=0))
        .limit(x=(0, 5), y=(0, None))
        .scale(x=(so.Continuous()
                  .tick(every=1, minor=0)
                  .label(like=lambda x, pos: f"{x:.0f}" if x != 5 else "5y")),
              y=so.Continuous().tick(minor=1).label(unit=("", "%")))
        .theme({"axes.grid.which": "both"} | rc_params)

def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl

# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"

dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output

def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl

3.2 Outcomes at a period of time after a route started
Period: 3.08 years
DV: dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"]

Code
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
print(f"Routes: {len(dpw_rt_ends):,}")
print("")
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )]
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
rts_excluded = {
    f"Routes started within 3.08 yrs of end ({distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt.strftime("%d/%m/%Y")})":
        (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure).sum(),
    "Routes with outcome: " + ", ".join(cat for cat in dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].unique() if cat not in rt_end_cat_map):
        ((dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
         & ~(dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))).sum()
}
excluded_df = pd.DataFrame(data=rts_excluded.values(), columns=["n"], index=rts_excluded.keys())
excluded_df.index = excluded_df.index.rename("Excluded routes")
display(excluded_df)
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"]
n = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Route outcome")
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
excel_output["Table 3.2: Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
print("""
::: {.callout-note}
- "Insecure outcome" includes still being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways,
  or level 3/4 in shared accommodation.
- "Independent outcome" includes being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways
:::
""")

              .join(next_pls[["pathway", "pathway_level"]].add_prefix("next_"))
              .assign(level_diff=lambda df: df[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]]
              .astype("Int64").diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]))
# Difference in level is meaningful except that moves to/from SU pathway are different..
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes.join((level_diff[["next_pathway_level", "level_diff"]]
                                .where((level_diff["pathway"] == level_diff["next_pathway"])
                                       | (level_diff["pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway")
                                       | (level_diff["next_pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway"))))
pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["level_diff"].notna(), "pl_end_cat"] = (
    "Internal move: " + np.sign(pl_outcomes.level_diff).map({-1: "backwards", 0: "sideways", 1: "forwards"})
)
# Exclude 738 placements that have not ended
pl_excluded["Not-ended placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].isna()]
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].notna()]
# Exclude 42 0-day placements
pl_excluded["Zero-day placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] == pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] > pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome (external)': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
pl_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in pl_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in pl_outcomes_map[outcome]}
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
pl_outcomes.loc[
    pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].fillna("").str.startswith("Internal move"),
    "pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"]
# Exclude 1,310 moves within the same service
pl_excluded["Moves within same service"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move: same service"]
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] != "Internal move: same service"]
# Exclude 277 moves due to end reasons: 53 missing reaons, 200 "Other"
# TODO: Should "Other" really be excluded?
### In [310]: pl_outcomes.set_index("pl_outcome").loc["Other"].pl_end_reason.astype("string").value_counts()
### Out[310]: 
### pl_end_reason
### Other (Planned)                                           141
### Other (Unplanned)                                          58
### (SSTS) BCC Emergency Accommodation (FOR SSTS USE ONLY)      1
### Name: count, dtype: Int64
pl_excluded["Unclear end categories"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"].isna()]
tbl_desc = "Table 3.7.2: Placements excluded from placement outcome DV construction"
tbl = pd.DataFrame([len(pls) for pls in pl_excluded.values()], index=pl_excluded.keys(), columns=["n"])
tbl.loc["All"] = tbl.sum()
print("### " + tbl_desc)
display(tbl)

# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
dpw_pls_orig = dpw_pls


def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl





Code
dv_dict = {}
#####################################
# 3.1 Entry point into BAHSA services
#####################################
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
rt_entries["pathway"] = rt_entries["svc_type_short"]
rt_entries["pathway_type"] = (rt_entries["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
dv_dict["Entry point into BAHSA services (pathway type and level)"] = (
    rt_entries[["route_id", "pathway_type", "pathway_level"]].set_index("route_id"))
#################################################
# 3.1.1 Entry point into BAHSA: pathway and level
#################################################
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
print(f"Routes: {len(rt_entries):,}")
rt_entries["pway_and_lvl"] = rt_entries["svc_typelvl"]
dv_dict["Entry point into BAHSA services (pathway and level)"] = (
    rt_entries[["route_id", "pway_and_lvl"]].set_index("route_id"))
#####################################
# 3.2 Route outcomes after 3.08 years
#####################################
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )]
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dv_dict["Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = (
                          dpw_rt_outcomes[["route_id", "rt_outcome"]].set_index("route_id"))
#######################################################################
# 3.3 Outcomes at a period of time after a person's first route started
#######################################################################
# dpw_cli_outcomes is the dpw_rt_outcome that is active after the measured time since the person's first route started
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
# Relevant date for each client is their first route start date plus the time measure period
dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes
                          .set_index("o_cli_id")
                          .groupby("o_cli_id")
                          .head(1)
                          ["rt_start_dt"]
                          + time_measure).rename("cli_timemeasure_dt")
dpw_cli_outcomes = dpw_rt_outcomes.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id").set_index("o_cli_id")
# Select the latest route that started before the outcome date
dpw_cli_outcomes = ((dpw_cli_outcomes[dpw_cli_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] <= dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_timemeasure_dt"]])
                    .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)).rename(columns={"rt_outcome": "cli_outcome"})
cli_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id")
cli_pls_at_timemeasures = cli_pls[(cli_pls["pl_start_dt"] < cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  & (
                                      cli_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                      | (cli_pls["pl_end_dt"] > cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  )].set_index("o_cli_id")
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[cli_pls_at_timemeasures.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
equiv_ind_at_time = cli_pls_at_timemeasures[
    (cli_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No")
    & cli_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"])]
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[equiv_ind_at_time.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_start_dt"] = (dpw_rt_starts.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                    .groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)["pl_start_dt"])
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_end_dt"] = (dpw_rt_ends.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)["pl_end_dt"])
dv_dict["Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"] = (
                          dpw_cli_outcomes[["cli_outcome"]])
##############################################
# 3.4 Returning to use services multiple times
##############################################
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["multiple_returns"] = (dpw_rt_starts.groupby(['o_cli_id']).size() >= 3).rename("multiple_returns")
dv_dict["People with multiple returns during 7.5 yrs"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["multiple_returns"]])
################################
# 3.5 Using services longer-term
################################
durations = dpw_pls.set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"]).groupby(["o_cli_id", "route_id"]).sum()
# Set threshold to top 10% of route durations
longer_term_threshold_days = durations.quantile(0.9)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"] = ((durations > longer_term_threshold_days)
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").any())
dv_dict["People with a route in top 10% of route durations"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["has_longer_term_rt"]])
######################################################################
# 3.6 Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation
######################################################################
# Note: Not enough returns after moves to independent accommodation to analyse much further.
# time_measure options: ['90d', '6m', '15m', '18m', '2y', '5y']
time_measure = "2y"
time_offset = distinct_pathways.stable_offsets[time_measure]
return_col = f"after_rt_ret_within_{time_measure}"
eligible_route_ends = dpw_rt_ends[
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to independent accommodation
    dpw_rt_ends["rt_end_cat"].isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"])
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    & (dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"] < distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_offset)]
dv_dict["Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation"] = (
                          eligible_route_ends[["route_id", return_col]].set_index("route_id"))

                          ["rt_start_dt"]
                          + time_measure).rename("cli_timemeasure_dt")
dpw_cli_outcomes = dpw_rt_outcomes.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id").set_index("o_cli_id")
# Select the latest route that started before the outcome date
dpw_cli_outcomes = ((dpw_cli_outcomes[dpw_cli_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] <= dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_timemeasure_dt"]])
                    .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)).rename(columns={"rt_outcome": "cli_outcome"})
cli_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id")
cli_pls_at_timemeasures = cli_pls[(cli_pls["pl_start_dt"] < cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  & (
                                      cli_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                      | (cli_pls["pl_end_dt"] > cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  )].set_index("o_cli_id")
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[cli_pls_at_timemeasures.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
equiv_ind_at_time = cli_pls_at_timemeasures[
    (cli_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No")
    & cli_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"])]
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[equiv_ind_at_time.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_start_dt"] = (dpw_rt_starts.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                    .groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)["pl_start_dt"])
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_end_dt"] = (dpw_rt_ends.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)["pl_end_dt"])
dv_dict["Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"] = (
                          dpw_cli_outcomes[["cli_outcome"]])
##############################################
# 3.4 Returning to use services multiple times
##############################################
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["multiple_returns"] = (dpw_rt_starts.groupby(['o_cli_id']).size() >= 3).rename("multiple_returns")
dv_dict["People with multiple returns during 7.5 yrs"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["multiple_returns"]])
################################
# 3.5 Using services longer-term
################################
durations = dpw_pls.set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"]).groupby(["o_cli_id", "route_id"]).sum()
# Set threshold to top 10% of route durations
longer_term_threshold_days = durations.quantile(0.9)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"] = ((durations > longer_term_threshold_days)
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").any())
dv_dict["People with a route in top 10% of route durations"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["has_longer_term_rt"]])
######################################################################
# 3.6 Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation
######################################################################
# Note: Not enough returns after moves to independent accommodation to analyse much further.
# time_measure options: ['90d', '6m', '15m', '18m', '2y', '5y']
time_measure = "2y"
time_offset = distinct_pathways.stable_offsets[time_measure]
return_col = f"after_rt_ret_within_{time_measure}"
eligible_route_ends = dpw_rt_ends[
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to independent accommodation
    dpw_rt_ends["rt_end_cat"].isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"])
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    & (dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"] < distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_offset)]
dv_dict["Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation"] = (
                          eligible_route_ends[["route_id", return_col]].set_index("route_id"))
#########################################
# 3.7 Outcomes from individual placements
#########################################
import numpy as np
from python_scripts import routes
pl_excluded = {}
pl_end_cat_map = routes.get_end_cats_map()
pl_outcomes = dpw_pls.set_index("vac_id")
pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_reason"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
next_pls = (dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_vac_id"].notna()]
            .rename(columns={"vac_id": "next_vac_id", "prev_vac_id": "vac_id", "svc_type_short": "pathway"})
            .set_index("vac_id"))
next_pls["pathway"] = next_pls["pathway"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes.loc[next_pls.index, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move"
pl_outcomes.loc[dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_svc_id"] == dpw_pls["svc_id"], "prev_vac_id"].values, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move: same service"
pl_outcomes["pathway"] = pl_outcomes["svc_type_short"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes["pathway_type"] = (pl_outcomes["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
pl_outcomes["ended"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "Current", False: "Ended"})
level_diff = (pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move", ["pathway", "pathway_level"]]
              .join(next_pls[["pathway", "pathway_level"]].add_prefix("next_"))
              .assign(level_diff=lambda df: df[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]]
              .astype("Int64").diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]))
# Difference in level is meaningful except that moves to/from SU pathway are different..
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes.join((level_diff[["next_pathway_level", "level_diff"]]
                                .where((level_diff["pathway"] == level_diff["next_pathway"])
                                       | (level_diff["pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway")
                                       | (level_diff["next_pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway"))))
pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["level_diff"].notna(), "pl_end_cat"] = (
    "Internal move: " + np.sign(pl_outcomes.level_diff).map({-1: "backwards", 0: "sideways", 1: "forwards"})
)
# Exclude 738 placements that have not ended
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].notna()]
# Exclude 42 0-day placements
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] > pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome (external)': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
pl_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in pl_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in pl_outcomes_map[outcome]}
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
pl_outcomes.loc[
    pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].fillna("").str.startswith("Internal move"),
    "pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"]
# Exclude 1,310 moves within the same service
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] != "Internal move: same service"]
# Exclude 277 moves due to end reasons: 53 missing reaons, 200 "Other"
# TODO: Should "Other" really be excluded?
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc[pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc["pl_outcome"].notna()]
dv_dict["Outcomes from individual placements"] = (
                              pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc[["pl_outcome"]])
dv_dict_desc = list(dv_dict.keys())
dv_dict_cats = {k: list(v.iloc[:, 0].astype("string").fillna("<N/A>").unique()) for k, v in dv_dict.items()}
display(dv_dict_desc)

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor as sm_vif

# Get DV
dv = dv_dict["Route outcomes after 3.08 years"].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])

# Get relevant IVs
idx_type = dv.index.name
match idx_type:
    case "vac_id":
        iv_df = dpw_pls
    case "route_id":
        iv_df = dpw_rt_starts
    case "o_cli_id":
        iv_df = dpw_clis
iv_df = iv_df[[idx_type] + characteristics].set_index(idx_type).loc[dv.index]

Xarr = []

# Start with two IVs
ch = "gender"
# Exclude non-binary because there are very few cases and some outcomes with no cases
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace(["Non-Binary", "_Unknown"], pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "global_majority"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "age_cat"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

## Excluded lgbtq_plus as adding resulted in statistically nonsignificant findings for all outcomes
# ch = "lgbtq_plus"
# Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# # Make the reference category the most common one
# Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# # Get dummies for this characteristic
# Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
# Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "multiple_disadvantage"
Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
# Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

# for ch in ["offending", "physical_health", "mental_health", "substance_use"]:
#     Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
#     Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
#     Xarr.append(Xn)

X = pd.concat(Xarr, axis=1)

# Add a constant to ensure intercept is calculated
Xc = sm.add_constant(X).rename(columns={"const": "(Intercept)"})

# Complete the multinomial logistic regression
results = sm.MNLogit(dv, Xc.astype("float")).fit()

display(results.summary())
params = results.params
params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
coef = params.unstack().rename("coef")
odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, results.conf_int().add_prefix("ci_")], axis=1)).add_suffix("_or")
pvalues = results.pvalues
pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
relevant_results = pd.concat([pvalues, odds_ratios], axis=1)
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(relevant_results)

vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data["Feature"] = X.columns
vif_data["VIF"] = [sm_vif(X.values, i) for i in range(len(X.columns))]
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor as sm_vif

# Get DV
dv = dv_dict["Route outcomes after 3.08 years"].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])
died_dv = (dv == "Died").rename("Died")
dv = dv.cat.remove_categories("Died")

# Get relevant IVs
idx_type = dv.index.name
match idx_type:
    case "vac_id":
        iv_df = dpw_pls
    case "route_id":
        iv_df = dpw_rt_starts
    case "o_cli_id":
        iv_df = dpw_clis
iv_df = iv_df[[idx_type] + characteristics].set_index(idx_type).loc[dv.index]

Xarr = []

ch = "gender"
# Exclude non-binary because there are very few cases and some outcomes with no cases
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace(["Non-Binary", "_Unknown"], pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "global_majority"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "uk_immigration_status"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "age_cat"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "lgbtq_plus"
Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

ch = "multiple_disadvantage"
Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
# Make the reference category the most common one
# Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
# Get dummies for this characteristic
Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
Xarr.append(Xn)

for ch in ["offending", "physical_health", "mental_health", "substance_use"]:
    Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)

for ch in ["rough_sleeping", "sex_working", "risk_violence_abuse", "risk_exploitation"]:
    Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)

X = pd.concat(Xarr, axis=1)

# Add a constant to ensure intercept is calculated
Xc = sm.add_constant(X).rename(columns={"const": "(Intercept)"})

# Alpha
alpha = 0.05

# Complete a binomial logistic regression for the category "Died"
# Columns removed iteratively for parsimony:
cols_to_remove = ["uk_immigration_status_Non-EEA National", "uk_immigration_status_EEA National",
                  "lgbtq_plus_Yes",  "substance_use_True", "gender_Female", "physical_health_True",
                  "risk_exploitation_True", "sex_working_True", "global_majority_Yes"]
died_X = Xc[[col for col in Xc.columns if col not in cols_to_remove]]
results = sm.Logit(died_dv, died_X.astype("float")).fit()
display(pd.Series(cols_to_remove).rename("Variables removed iteratively for parsimony").to_frame())
display(results.summary(alpha=alpha))

coef = results.params.rename("coef")
ci = results.conf_int()
ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
pvalues = results.pvalues.rename("p")
pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).map({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(results_or)

# Complete the multinomial logistic regression
results = sm.MNLogit(dv, Xc.astype("float")).fit()
display(results.summary(alpha=alpha))

params = results.params
params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
coef = params.unstack().rename("coef")
ci = results.conf_int()
ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
pvalues = results.pvalues
pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= 0.05).map({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
psummary = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig], axis=1).unstack(0).swaplevel(axis=1).sort_index(axis=1, ascending=[True, False])
results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(results_or)

vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data["Feature"] = X.columns
vif_data["VIF"] = [sm_vif(X.values, i) for i in range(len(X.columns))]
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)
    display(psummary)

    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"

    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    coef = params.unstack().rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        prev_results = results
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        prev_coef = prev_coef.unstack().rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])

Binomial logistic regression for the category “Died”
This category had substantial differences from other outcomes.

Iterative model development


Code
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05


def binomial_regression(died_dv, Xc, cols_to_remove):
    global prev_results
    died_X = Xc[[col for col in Xc.columns if col not in cols_to_remove]]
    results = sm.Logit(died_dv, died_X.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    coef = results.params.rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues.rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).map({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        prev_results = results
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_results.params.rename("prev_coef"), results.params.rename("coef")], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    display(summary)
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
        display(results_or.sort_values("p", ascending=False))
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    return results, summary, results_or

results = sm.MNLogit(dv, Xc.astype("float")).fit()
display(results.summary(alpha=alpha))

params = results.params
params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
coef = params.unstack().rename("coef")
ci = results.conf_int()
ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
pvalues = results.pvalues
pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= 0.05).map({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
psummary = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig], axis=1).unstack(0).swaplevel(axis=1).sort_index(axis=1, ascending=[True, False])
results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(results_or)

vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data["Feature"] = X.columns
vif_data["VIF"] = [sm_vif(X.values, i) for i in range(len(X.columns))]
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)
    display(psummary)

Test associations between IVs


Code
import scipy.stats as ss
from itertools import product
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05
iv_df_used = iv_df[iv_cols_used]
iv_df_used = iv_df_used.dropna()
# Ensure relevant variables exclude cases where results are NA
X = X.loc[iv_df_used.index]
Xc = Xc.loc[iv_df_used.index]
dv = dv.loc[iv_df_used.index]
# Test chi squared and Cramer's V for contingency tables
iv_prod = [(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in product(iv_df_used.columns, repeat=2) if iv1 != iv2]
def chi2(iv1, iv2):
    ct = pd.crosstab(iv_df_used[iv1], iv_df_used[iv2])
    chi2, pvalue, dof, arr = ss.chi2_contingency(ct)
    if pvalue < 0.001: p_sig = "***"
    elif pvalue < 0.01: p_sig = "**"
    elif pvalue < alpha: p_sig = "*"
    else: p_sig = ""
    cr_v = ss.contingency.association(ct, method="cramer")
    return (chi2, pvalue, p_sig, dof, cr_v)
results = (pd.DataFrame([(iv1, iv2) + chi2(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in iv_prod],
                        columns=["iv1", "iv2", "chi2", "p", "p_sig", "df", "cr_v"]))
results["iv2"] = results["iv2"].str.replace(r"^(.)[^_]*|_(.)[^_]*", r"\1\2", regex=True)
results["disp"] = results["p_sig"] + results["cr_v"].apply("{:,.3f}".format)
pvalues = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p").rename_axis("p", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
p_sig = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p_sig").rename_axis("*", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
cr_v = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="cr_v").rename_axis("V", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
disp = pd.concat([cr_v, p_sig], keys=["V", "*"]).swaplevel().sort_index(ascending=[True, False])

title: 07. Multinomial logistic regression modelling
text:
Model building


Code
from IPython.display import Markdown

def multinomial_regression(dv, Xc, cols_to_remove):
    global prev_results
    selectedXc = Xc[[col for col in Xc.columns if col not in cols_to_remove]]
    results = sm.MNLogit(dv, selectedXc.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    coef = params.unstack().rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        prev_results = results
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        prev_coef = prev_coef.unstack().rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        coef = coef.unstack().rename("coef")
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_coef, coef], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    display(summary)
    results_or = results_or.loc[results_or["p"].groupby(level=1).transform("min").sort_values(ascending=False).index].swaplevel()
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format, "display.max_rows", 120):
        display(results_or.head(120))
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    print("-" * 50)
    print("")
    return results, summary, results_or


iter = 0

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor as sm_vif

# Get DV
dv_str = "Route outcomes after 3.08 years"
dv = dv_dict[dv_str].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])

title: 07. Multinomial logistic regression modelling
text:
Prepare IVs


Code
def get_ivs(dv, cols_to_exclude):
    global dpw_pls, dpw_rt_starts, dpw_clis, characteristics
    # Get relevant IVs
    idx_type = dv.index.name
    match idx_type:
        case "vac_id":
            iv_df = dpw_pls
        case "route_id":
            iv_df = dpw_rt_starts
        case "o_cli_id":
            iv_df = dpw_clis
    iv_df = iv_df[[idx_type] + characteristics].set_index(idx_type).loc[dv.index]
    
    Xarr = []
    iv_cols_used = []
    
    ch = "gender"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    # Exclude non-binary because there are very few cases and some outcomes with no cases
    Xn = iv_df[ch].replace(["Non-Binary", "_Unknown"], pd.NA).astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    ch = "global_majority"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    ch = "uk_immigration_status"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    ch = "age_cat"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    ch = "lgbtq_plus"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    Xn = iv_df[ch].replace("_Unknown", pd.NA).astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    ch = "multiple_disadvantage"
    iv_cols_used.append(ch)
    Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
    # Make the reference category the most common one
    # Xn = Xn.cat.reorder_categories(list(Xn.value_counts().index))
    # Get dummies for this characteristic
    Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
    Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    for ch in ["offending", "physical_health", "mental_health", "substance_use"]:
        iv_cols_used.append(ch)
        Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
        Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
        Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    for ch in ["rough_sleeping", "sex_working", "risk_violence_abuse", "risk_exploitation"]:
        iv_cols_used.append(ch)
        Xn = iv_df[ch].astype("category")
        Xn = pd.get_dummies(Xn, prefix=ch, drop_first=True)
        Xarr.append(Xn)
    
    X = pd.concat(Xarr, axis=1)
    X = X[[col for col in X.columns if col not in cols_to_exclude]]
    iv_cols_used = [col for col in iv_cols_used if col not in cols_to_exclude]
    
    # Add a constant to ensure intercept is calculated
    Xc = sm.add_constant(X).rename(columns={"const": "(Intercept)"})
    
    return X, Xc, iv_df, iv_cols_used

import scipy.stats as ss
from itertools import product
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05
iv_df_used = iv_df[iv_cols_used]
iv_df_used = iv_df_used.dropna()
# Ensure relevant variables exclude cases where results are NA
X = X.loc[iv_df_used.index]
Xc = Xc.loc[iv_df_used.index]
dv = dv.loc[iv_df_used.index]
# Test chi squared and Cramer's V for contingency tables
iv_prod = [(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in product(iv_df_used.columns, repeat=2) if iv1 != iv2]
def chi2(iv1, iv2):
    ct = pd.crosstab(iv_df_used[iv1], iv_df_used[iv2])
    chi2, pvalue, dof, arr = ss.chi2_contingency(ct)
    if pvalue < 0.001: p_sig = "***"
    elif pvalue < 0.01: p_sig = "**"
    elif pvalue < alpha: p_sig = "*"
    else: p_sig = ""
    cr_v = ss.contingency.association(ct, method="cramer")
    return (chi2, pvalue, p_sig, dof, cr_v)
results = (pd.DataFrame([(iv1, iv2) + chi2(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in iv_prod],
                        columns=["iv1", "iv2", "chi2", "p", "p_sig", "df", "cr_v"]))
results["iv2"] = results["iv2"].str.replace(r"^(.)[^_]*|_(.)[^_]*", r"\1\2", regex=True)
results["disp"] = results["p_sig"] + results["cr_v"].apply("{:,.3f}".format)
pvalues = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p").rename_axis("p", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
p_sig = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p_sig").rename_axis("*", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
cr_v = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="cr_v").rename_axis("V", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
disp = pd.concat([cr_v, p_sig], keys=["V", "*"]).swaplevel().sort_index(ascending=[True, False])

title: 07. Multinomial logistic regression modelling
text:
Model building


Code
from IPython.display import Markdown


def multinomial_regression(dv, Xc, cols_to_remove):
    global prev_results
    selectedXc = Xc[[col for col in Xc.columns if col not in cols_to_remove]]
    results = sm.MNLogit(dv, selectedXc.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    coef = params.unstack().rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        prev_results = results
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        prev_coef = prev_coef.unstack().rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        coef = coef.unstack().rename("coef")
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_coef, coef], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    display(summary)
    results_or = results_or.loc[results_or["p"].groupby(level=1).transform("min").sort_values(ascending=False).index].swaplevel()
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
        display(results_or)
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    print("-" * 50)
    print("")
    return results, summary, results_or


iter = 0

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor as sm_vif

# Get DV
dv_str = "Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"
dv = dv_dict[dv_str].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])

title: 07. Multinomial logistic regression modelling
text:

cols_to_exclude = ["multiple_disadvantage_True"]
X, Xc, iv_df, iv_cols_used = get_ivs(dv, cols_to_exclude)

iv_df_used = iv_df_used.dropna()
# Ensure relevant variables exclude cases where results are NA
X = X.loc[iv_df_used.index]
Xc = Xc.loc[iv_df_used.index]
dv = dv.loc[iv_df_used.index]

from IPython.display import Markdown


def binomial_regression(dv, Xc, cols_to_remove):
    global prev_results
    selectedXc = Xc[[col for col in Xc.columns if col not in cols_to_remove]]
    results = sm.Logit(dv, selectedXc.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    coef = params.rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues = pvalues.rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        prev_results = results
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef = prev_coef.rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef = coef.rename("coef")
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_coef, coef], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    display(summary)
    results_or = results_or.loc[results_or["p"].sort_values(ascending=False).index]
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
        display(results_or)
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    print("-" * 50)
    print("")
    return results, summary, results_or

iter = 0

title: 07. Multinomial logistic regression modelling
text:
Test associations between IVs


Code
import scipy.stats as ss
from itertools import product
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05
iv_df_used = iv_df[iv_cols_used]
iv_df_used = iv_df_used.dropna()
# Ensure relevant variables exclude cases where results are NA
X = X.loc[iv_df_used.index]
Xc = Xc.loc[iv_df_used.index]
dv = dv.loc[iv_df_used.index]
# Test chi squared and Cramer's V for contingency tables
iv_prod = [(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in product(iv_df_used.columns, repeat=2) if iv1 != iv2]
def chi2(iv1, iv2):
    ct = pd.crosstab(iv_df_used[iv1], iv_df_used[iv2])
    chi2, pvalue, dof, arr = ss.chi2_contingency(ct)
    if pvalue < 0.001: p_sig = "***"
    elif pvalue < 0.01: p_sig = "**"
    elif pvalue < alpha: p_sig = "*"
    else: p_sig = ""
    cr_v = ss.contingency.association(ct, method="cramer")
    return (chi2, pvalue, p_sig, dof, cr_v)
results = (pd.DataFrame([(iv1, iv2) + chi2(iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in iv_prod],
                        columns=["iv1", "iv2", "chi2", "p", "p_sig", "df", "cr_v"]))
results["iv2"] = results["iv2"].str.replace(r"^(.)[^_]*|_(.)[^_]*", r"\1\2", regex=True)
results["disp"] = results["p_sig"] + results["cr_v"].apply("{:,.3f}".format)
pvalues = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p").rename_axis("p", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
p_sig = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="p_sig").rename_axis("*", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
cr_v = results.pivot(index="iv1", columns="iv2", values="cr_v").rename_axis("V", axis=1).rename_axis(None)
disp = pd.concat([cr_v, p_sig], keys=["V", "*"]).swaplevel().sort_index(ascending=[True, False])
